reasoning_content:
Bundler 2.6.9 is default. Good. Elasticsearch gem 8.11.2 but compose uses elasticsearch:9.3.2 image. Let me use ES 9.3.2 as in compose. Now let's start services. First PostgreSQL.

Let me start postgresql, redis, elasticsearch via docker (ES is heavy, easiest via docker).

Let me start PostgreSQL service and configure a zammad user. The compose uses zammad:zammad. Let me create that.

Actually I'll start the services and set up the DB.

Let me start postgres (native) and redis (native), and ES via docker.

First postgres: 
```
pg_ctlcluster 14 main start
sudo -u postgres createuser -s zammad -P  (password zammad)
```
Actually the database.yml sample uses default (no username), which would connect as the current OS user (root). Root superuser role may not exist in PG. Let me create a role for zammad with password and set DATABASE_URL env instead.

Compose sets DATABASE_URL: postgres://zammad:zammad@postgresql:5432. When DATABASE_URL is set, Rails merges. The devcontainer note says "Don't specify the postgresql database here. This will get merged with an existing database.yml." Hmm, DATABASE_URL without db path gets merged with database.yml.

I'll set DATABASE_URL=postgres://zammad:zammad@localhost:5432 and it'll merge with database.yml which specifies database names. Good.

Let me start.

action.command:
set -x
service postgresql start
sleep 3
service redis-server start
sleep 2
pg_lsclusters
redis-cli ping
sudo -u postgres psql -c "SELECT version();" | head -2
